item: HTTP detail: every detail built from a caught exception goes through secret_scrub.http_detail (R140)
summary: Every HTTPException detail in src/api that carries a caught exception's text now goes through one helper, http_detail(exc, prefix): a database driver's error anywhere in the cause chain (sqlite3, sqlcipher3, SQLAlchemy and its wrappers), a wrapper that quotes one, or a UnicodeError is the prefix and the class only; any other exception keeps its words with every held passphrase and the caller's secrets taken out before any cut, and the class alone if the scrub cannot run. The fixed sentences the lock screen and the release run show for an unreadable text are kept (withheld argument). The records guard now reads all of src/api and fails on a new detail made from an exception by f-string, str, format, concatenation or repr, with a negative control for each spelling.
